run.title: Move Selected Native Cart Items to Zepto

steps: Select the saved home Zepto delivery address
Review the result without confirming an order

checks.name: saved address required before sync
checks.observation: Move to Zepto cart was disabled until the home address was selected.

checks.name: store context established before product search
checks.observation: The sync completed with store_context_ready and the UI displayed Zepto store ready.

checks.name: Zepto review is populated
checks.observation: The review displayed 17 resolved rows and 15 unavailable rows.

checks.name: native cart is preserved
checks.observation: The durable grocery_cart still contained 32 rows after sync.

checks.name: no order is placed
checks.observation: Confirm Order remained disabled and no order request was made.

checks.name: resolved products accurately represent native items
checks.observation: Unrelated substitutions included almond-milk biscuits for Milk / Almond Milk, Ash Gourd for Green Beans, and cough syrup for Sugar-Free Syrup.

diagnosis.remaining_issue: The provider adapter accepts the first available Zepto search result without adequate relevance validation or SKU deduplication.
